lab.name: SEAL
lab.tagline: Building intelligent systems that sense, move, and act in the physical world.
lab.mission: SEAL researches the systems that let artificial intelligence step off the screen and into the physical world — from perception and control to learning in embodied agents. We work at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and systems design.
lab.address: North South University, Bashundhara, Dhaka, Bangladesh

focusAreas.title: Embodied AI & Robot Learning
focusAreas.blurb: Agents that learn by acting — training policies through physical interaction rather than static datasets alone.

focusAreas.title: Perception & Control Systems
focusAreas.blurb: Turning noisy sensor streams into reliable state estimates, and state estimates into stable, safe control.

focusAreas.title: Artificial Intelligence
focusAreas.blurb: Encompassing core machine learning paradigms, automated reasoning, and sequential decision-making to build adaptive systems capable of scaling from simulation to real-world deployment.

focusAreas.title: Human-Robot Interaction
focusAreas.blurb: Designing robot behavior that people can predict, trust, and work alongside safely.

projects.title: LexiKan-AI
projects.description: LexiKAN AI is an advanced legal intelligence platform utilizing BiGRU and Kolmogorov–Arnold Neural Networks (KAN) for precise 11-way judgment disposition classification and automated structural case note summary generation.

projects.title: CGIAR-RicePredict: Multi-Target Agronomic Intelligence for Crop Yield and Quality
projects.description: CGIAR-RicePredict is a multi-target AI system designed to simultaneously estimate grain yield, zinc, and iron content in rice crops. By evaluating soil, climate, genotype, and management parameters, it empowers precision agriculture with concurrent forecasts of yield and micronutrient quality.

projects.title: A Smart Humanoid Robot
projects.description: An autonomous system combining advanced computer vision, natural language processing, and precise physical actuation to perceive its environment, reason through complex tasks, and interact seamlessly alongside humans.

news.text: Our team is excited to participate and present our latest research at BEAR SUMMIT 2026.
New preprint on enhancing BiGRU with KAN blocks for legal document classification and summarization released on arXiv.
Research paper accepted on fine-tuning Whisper and PyAnnote for Bangla long-form speech recognition and speaker diarization.
PlantaNet and PlantaNetLite accepted in PLoS One, featuring efficient crop disease classification via custom lightweight CNNs.
Work accepted for the 2026 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Cognitive Engineering focusing on underwater semantic segmentation.
New initiative launched exploring agentic reasoning frameworks and self-correcting multi-domain models in quantized 7B-8B LLMs.
Kicked off collaborative research on spatiotemporal forecasting and weather modeling across smart infrastructure.
